name: feature-pipeline
description: End-to-end feature pipeline: clone a repo, interactively brainstorm a spec and phased designs, then automatically align docs, produce plans, implement task-by-task (TDD), refine via the native ralph loop, and open a PR. Self-contained: all brainstorming/planning/execution processes are native template content with no external skill dependency.
author: arbitron

inputs.name: repo_url
inputs.description: GitHub repo URL to clone and work in.

inputs.name: slug
inputs.description: Feature slug; auto-derived from the spec brainstorm if empty.

inputs.name: max_impl_iterations
inputs.description: Backstop cap on the draft-impl loop.

inputs.name: max_ralph_iterations
inputs.description: Backstop cap on the ralph refinement loop.

nodes.label: Init workspace
nodes.description: Clone repo_url into {{workspace}}/src, derive slug + run_date, create the dev-{slug} worktree at {{workspace}}/work.

nodes.label: Done (terminal)
nodes.description: Terminal node. Records final status so the walk ends cleanly.
